top3s: Do these first for the biggest improvement
f1d: Your router still uses a factory login. Choose a long, new password.
f2d: The WPS PIN has only 8 digits and can be guessed. Switch it off in router settings.
f3d: Telnet sends passwords without protection. Disable it.
fWifiD: Switch from open Wi-Fi to WPA2 or WPA3 encryption.
fWepD: Upgrade outdated WEP security to WPA2-AES immediately.
fHttpOnlyD: Enable HTTPS management in your router settings.
fUpnpD: Turn off UPnP to prevent malware from opening ports.
fTr069D: Disable remote TR-069 management if unused.
fDnsD: Set trusted resolvers like Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Google (8.8.8.8).
fFwD: Keep router firmware updated for the latest security patches.
